results.title: Clean climate notebook reproduction
recommendedActions: Allow repository execution, merge, and tagged release with normal provenance.

results.title: Model benchmark rerun with open egress and host secrets

findings.message: The execution container is not pinned by a content digest.
findings.remediation: Pin the runner image with a sha256 digest before publishing or merging the reproducibility run.

findings.message: The command hash or dependency lockfile evidence is missing.
findings.remediation: Attach hashed commands and dependency lock evidence for the exact pipeline revision.

findings.message: The reproducibility run allows open or wildcard network egress.
findings.remediation: Deny egress by default or replace it with a narrow host allowlist and cached inputs.

findings.message: Secret-like environment variables are available to the repository execution sandbox.
findings.remediation: Remove secrets from reproducibility runs and replace live credentials with synthetic or read-only fixtures.

findings.message: Host secret paths are mounted into the repository execution sandbox.
findings.remediation: Remove host secret mounts and use declared, non-sensitive repository fixtures.

findings.message: The sandbox uses privileged, root, host PID, or host IPC execution settings.
findings.remediation: Run the container as a non-root user without privileged mode or host namespace sharing.

findings.message: The sandbox has unsafe host mounts or writable paths outside declared artifact locations.
findings.remediation: Restrict mounts to read-only workspace inputs and writable results/artifacts directories.

findings.message: The execution plan lacks one or more resource caps.
findings.remediation: Set CPU, memory, timeout, and artifact-size caps before queueing the run.

findings.message: One or more output paths escape declared results or artifacts directories.
findings.remediation: Write outputs only under repository-scoped results/ or artifacts/ paths.

findings.message: Repository merge or public release remains enabled while sandbox findings are unresolved.
findings.remediation: Freeze protected-branch merge, DOI tagging, and public reproducibility badges until sandbox findings are cleared.

recommendedActions: Freeze protected-branch merge, DOI tagging, and public reproducibility badges.
Attach sandbox findings to the repository review packet.
Re-run the exact reproducibility pipeline after remediation.
Preserve reviewer evidence with the tagged release record.
